name: Immigration counsel (category guide)
summary: Category entry for EP refusals/appeals, IPA reassessment / postpone-arrival freezes, IPA medical form mismatches, salary-cut notify / DP cascade, age-banded qualifying salary vs COMPASS C1, job-change IPA sequencing, FWTES address blockers, passport/particulars updates, Tech.Pass, PEP one-shot timing, ONE Pass spouse LOC vs ordinary EP DP work rules, EntrePass TBS/LWF renewals, LTVP common-law, visit-pass extensions, Work Holiday / Training EP, lost-card edge cases, FCF timing, ACRA/officer LOC questions, Tuition Grant / NS edge cases, retrenchment STVP asks, DP cascade / LOC renewal local-hire failures, training-bond exit timing, and side-income questions — use regulated advisers when HR scripts run out.
body: Most straightforward EP issues are employer-led via MOM. Engage immigration counsel for refusals and 3-month employer-only appeals, post-IPA reassessment / postpone-arrival freezes (IPA can still be revoked; only employer/agent can chase MOM), IPA/medical issuance clocks that collide with STVP expiry (wrong Work Permit medical PDFs, lab delays, doctor-memo STVP extensions), offers that miss the published age-banded EP floor (non-FS from S$5,600 / FS from S$6,200 at the youngest band in current tables, with 2027/2028 steps already published), or confusion between Stage 1 qualifying salary and COMPASS C1 percentiles. Employers must notify MOM at least one month before lowering EP salary — revised floors can revoke DP/LTVP privileges; occupation updates and related-company transfers are employer notify paths, not handshake title changes. Job changes need a new employer IPA before resignation — dual pending filings and related-company transfers are easy to botch; IR21 still fires when you stay in Singapore. Residential address and mobile updates are a 5-day pass-holder clock; private-condo FWTES landlord consent blockers and passport renewals that break automated gates are admin problems counsel sees when composition fines or travel collide with stubborn owners. Complex dependants, common-law LTVP evidence packs, EntrePass / Tech.Pass / ONE Pass conversions, PEP one-shot timing, or PR strategy — not for routine first-pass filing your HR already owns. ONE Pass spouse LOC (employer or business, one LOC at a time) is a different product from ordinary EP/S Pass DP employment — counsel helps when dual-career households confuse the two or when EntrePass renewal TBS/LWF local-hire ladders collide with family relocation timing. ACRA incorporation via a CSP is not a work pass; EP secondary directorship and DP business LOCs are MOM products with related-company and local-hire traps — LOC renewals that fail the Local Qualifying Salary + three-month CPF hire rule often need a counsel-shaped pivot to EP rather than informal trading. Short internship and working-holiday paths (Work Holiday Programme, AU/NZ Work & Holiday, Training Employment Pass) are easy to confuse with tourist visit passes — counsel helps when schools sit off MOM’s sample lists or employers invent illegal ‘start first, pass later’ plans. Fair Consideration Framework advertising (≥14 days on MyCareersFuture unless exempt) sits before many EP submissions; counsel helps when ICT exemptions, salary-band mismatches, or debarment risk enter the chat. Short-Term Visit Pass confusion is common: ICA online extensions while waiting for a first pass are not the same as MOM’s post-cancellation STVP — ask HR in writing for up to 90 days on cancel for the whole household; overstaying or JB visa runs are how clean files become messy. After retrenchment, parallel a contractual benefit / TADM path; counsel helps when DP/LTVP cascade or graduate LTVP timing is non-standard. Training bonds and clawbacks are contract fights that should not be confused with MOM cancellation clocks. Lost or stolen pass cards are usually an HR EP eService replacement within one week; counsel helps when repeated losses trigger interviews or when you are stuck overseas without a re-entry letter. Side-income questions (content creation, overseas remote on DP) start from MOM FAQs; counsel helps when your employer’s risk team will not accept a link alone. Male ex-PRs who renounced before NS should get written CMPB clarity before assuming an EP transfer will clear — COMPASS is not a NS waiver. International graduates on MOE Tuition Grant bonds need counsel when liquidated-damages clocks collide with pass cancellation. Foreign spouses leaving abusive sponsors need immigration advice *after* safety (NAVH / PPO) — pass dependency myths should not delay police or Protection Specialist Centres. Death of a main pass holder is an ICA + estate problem, not a Facebook pass conversion.
whenToEngage: Job-change IPA sequencing or FWTES address blockers
Complex dependants, common-law LTVP, or pass cascade
ONE Pass spouse LOC vs ordinary EP DP work rules
Tech.Pass / ONE Pass / EntrePass / PEP conversions
EntrePass TBS/LWF renewal or side-income / LOC failures
